proof_policy: Publication does not establish signature/output/security/behavior or native parity. No 11.x runtime exists; current retail 12.1.0 is observed with all later supersessions. Main-thread local development, not independent/native acceptance. Exact cached deprecation aliases are not raw absence. Non-inventory contracts remain pending; external linked pages are not expanded. Existing ledgers unchanged.

capabilities.implementation: Eleven bounded fixes: combat/gradient readback, four fog CVars, five namespace retirements. Retail-12-0-0 gates preserve classic profiles.
capabilities.proof: Eight isolated GREEN sweeps; seven later observations identical; negative control adds exactly one gap. Five bounded behavioral tests GREEN after RED.
